latency.method: nearest-rank P95; 50 distinct topic IDs, one query per topic after index build; no warmup
latency.limitations: single synthetic template; varied query IDs do not establish task diversity; in-process not HTTP/SDK latency

sensitive.definition: request-level sensitive classification; NOT entity/span-level F1

sources.preference_accuracy: unchanged v2 test labels, through real lifecycle gate
sources.knowledge_recall: v3 test Recall@3, dev-only threshold selection
sources.conflict_accuracy: v2 test detection plus labeled resolution assertions

gaps: Preference accuracy below 85%; do not weaken lifecycle gates to conceal this.
Preference/retrieval/conflict sets lack 50 independent requests each.
Sensitive F1 is request-level, not a certified official definition.
Public synthetic labels with HashEmbedding; no real SDK/model end-to-end evidence.
